axes: +X body left, +Y up, +Z anterior (same as si_scene_v1.glb)
note: mesh: centerline and radius estimated from the glb mesh (level-set rings between open boundary loops, refined by plane slices); generated: schematic, not anatomical data (intrarenal vessels, glomerulus, capillary net, link into the right atrium).

validation.method: mesh segments: 8 rays perpendicular to the path from a point offset 0.5 r from the centerline must hit the vessel mesh (union of listed nodes) within 4 r; kidney-interior routes: point inside the convex hull of the renal capsule mesh with 0.5 mm margin (the capsule is a thin shell open at the hilum, so ray tests are unreliable)
